description.content:
Partial OpenAPI for the Eventbrite Platform API. The official Eventbrite Python SDK at https://github.com/eventbrite/eventbrite-sdk-python confirms the base URL https://www.eventbriteapi.com/v3 and the /users/me/, /events/{id}/, and /ticket_classes endpoint patterns. The surrounding resources (organizations, orders, attendees, venues, categories) follow the same conventions documented at https://www.eventbrite.com/platform/api. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 bearer token (private token or OAuth-issued token).
